description: Use when an authenticated user wants their XP marketplace Privy embedded-wallet address and USDC balance (e.g. 'what's my wallet for tickets to tonight?', 'how much USDC before I make an offer?'). Returns the wallet address, a `wallet_connected` flag, and the USDC balance — never the raw bearer token. Read-only; requires auth and read:account scope. Used to fund offers on the live offer book.
name: get_my_wallet
title: Get My Wallet
